data.name: Nayara Alto Atacama
data.address: Camino Pukará, Suchor s/n, San Pedro de Atacama, Antofagasta, Chile
data.description:
Surrounded by mountains in the Atacama Desert, this refined all-inclusive lodge is a 5-minute walk from the Pukará de Quitor archaeological site and 3 km from Ruta 23 highway.
Relaxed rooms offer Wi-Fi access, safes and minibars, plus terraces with sitting areas and mountain views. Suites add open-air bathrooms.
In addition to meals and drinks, guided walks and loaner bikes are included. There's also a restaurant, a bar and an open-air eatery. Other amenities consist of gardens, terraces and 6 outdoor pools, as well as a spa with hot tubs, a sauna and a steam room.
